explanation: All 32 rubric items were assessed. Score is 100*(32-0-0)/32 = 100. Independent SHA256 matched all 19 frozen files at HEAD 6a94038; no checks were run here. This local pass does not mark Task 4, the story, or the native fence done.
fowler_smells: Long Method: the complete backend and native acceptance traces are long cohesive sequences; CONVENTIONS has no line cap, and splitting them would hide ordering, so no refactor is required.
Switch Statements: fixture mode dispatch is an if-ladder; a provider or plugin framework is forbidden, so no refactor is required.

rubric.evidence: Diff 5311409..HEAD changes production only in src/acp.rs. Frozen hashes match for Authority, client, TUI, runtime ProcessTree, Cargo.toml, and Cargo.lock. No new dependency or public protocol.

tests/acp/acceptance.rs and tests/acp/native/acceptance.rs keep the captured target tuple after force, close, and handoff. src/acp.rs projection builds that tuple from instance id, generation, and session; force does not replace it.
s03_same_work comparisons retain prompt rpc_id. tests/fixtures/acp_peer.rs writes effect.json rpc_id from the original prompt request, not a later owner.
form_bonus and permission_allows require wire ids reusable-form and 73. Acceptance tests assert new interaction_id, work_id, and call_id for each reuse.
tests/fixtures/acp_peer.rs form_bonus returns the submitted integer bonus, not the schema default. Cases use 7, 11, 5, and 99.
Fixture offers opaque-α/β allow_once/always and opaque-γ/δ reject_once/always. Backend and native cases select each kind.
tool-effect-N is written only when permission_allows is true. Allow cases observe 49 and 57 plus the effect file.
Reject options do not add arithmetic or write tool-effect. Native deny stays at 49/count 2 with tool-effect-2 absent.
src/control.rs force only grants. Fixture writes unexpected-cancel only for session/cancel. Tests assert that file absent and the descendant still alive.
Prepared form and permission envelopes are denied stale-control/stale-handle after a fresh generation. Stale interaction ids are denied stale-interaction.
src/tui.rs continues after active ACP handling and does not fall through to native input. Native paste, repeat, mouse, focus, and double-prefix do not create tool-effect-1 or the pasted prompt.
After release, native action 12 is a new cooperative request. Returned generation differs, and the old envelopes are denied.
Native test arms human-idle on the original attachment, records consent, and keep/withdraw leave that human controller in place.
Conditional keep/withdraw does not grant the requester, does not answer the pending form, and does not change the human generation.
Admitted answer and permission work assert the admitting controller_id and owner_generation, including post-force and returned-human generations.
s04_held_prompt observes accepted, delivery not-submitted, null outcome, and no effect.json before the read barrier is released.
Held-stdin test runs snapshot, force, and unrelated add 19 23 concurrently. The sibling completes at 42 while s04-reads.release is absent.
Successor control-handle read returns the original held work after the admitting socket is dropped. Identities match the pre-loss record.
src/acp.rs close marks unfinished work unknown before pipe cancellation. Projection hardcodes application unknown. Close and retained-pipe tests observe unknown, not application.
Close admission is observed before shutdown. Only UnexpectedEof or ConnectionReset after that admission is classified; it is not turned into application or an authority success.
Five hostile modes fail only their instance and still join. The sibling completes the original RPC at 57 with tool-effect-1 and no unexpected-cancel.
drain_stderr keeps reading after the retention cap and sets stderr_truncated. The noisy child still accepts a later prompt after stderr-drained appears.
Provider failure is outcome code -32603 only. Private error and question strings are absent from snapshot, events, and default inspect.
run setsid before spawn. ProcessTree capture requires session equal to pid. Tests compare getsid, getpgid, and unchanged peer.pid bytes.

src/acp.rs stores stopped, drops the sole wake sender, then joins every started handle. A still-held endpoint sets retained and failure cleanup. cleanup_complete false still counts in reserve. The retainer test sees the process alive after close and shutdown, capacity rejection at 8, and no release file. Rust 1.95 UnixStream::pair sets CLOEXEC before spawn.

Sentinel is an unrelated sleep and alive() fails if it was reaped. Fixture fallback signals only its own session group, and only if fixture-fallback exists. Tests assert that file absent. Retainer release is a file, not a PID signal.
tests/acp/native.rs detach compares full termios, pins the host, and joins the PTY reader. finish reaps descendant.pid before fallback. Parent 1457 lists this native case; I did not run it.

e04s04-retained-pipe-runtime.json records close and shutdown before retainer release, unknown not application, and explicitly says drainer_joined means no PTY drainer was started. Consistent with the cancellation code. Not re-executed here and not a latency guarantee.
e04s04-verify.yaml names the same 8 source tests, states suites overlap, and says summary 0.00s is not duration. It includes one showcase and two native guards. Artifact 1457 was not re-parsed here.
BUG-e03-native-settlement.md and e04s04-native-fence.json keep native settlement unresolved and caps unchanged. All four task ledgers remain failing. No live-adapter test exists.

Tests use barriers and publication predicates, not sleep as success. PipeIo is private. No new public type, provider trait, or protocol. CONVENTIONS remains the 12-line file. Long traces are not a required split.

No fake live driver, receipt verifier, or counted zero-case command. Evidence keeps Task 4 and the story failing. The real driver is absent and not reachable without separate approval and missing bindings; that limit is not treated as story completion.
